headline: Aisha understands the intention, roll, wisdom, reflection, and observation loop before she enters the game.
overview: A live product-level walk for Leela Quest · Web, framed around Aisha Karim's actual decision rather than a list of routes.
targetAudience: Arrives with a real decision she has been circling for weeks and wants a structured reflection, not a prediction or a generic meditation app.

steps.title: A journey, not a fortune teller
steps.action: Opened the public Leela Quest introduction.
steps.description: The product frames the board as self-discovery through ancient wisdom and offers native and browser entry points.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest introduction and platform links

steps.title: The full reflection loop is visible
steps.description: Aisha sees that the product begins with her intention, uses the roll to create a prompt, and ends with reflection and observation.

steps.title: Rules turn symbolism into a usable practice
steps.description: The guide explains how intention, dice, snakes, arrows, and square meanings work together so the ritual is learnable rather than mystical UI.

steps.title: The 72-square board can be studied before a roll
steps.description: The board reference exposes the map and its states outside a live session, giving Aisha context for the guidance she will receive.

steps.title: The product hands off to the real game
steps.description: The browser build is the actual Flutter game surface. Native iPhone evidence is published separately so this web handoff is not misrepresented as mobile-app proof.

keyFeatures: Roll and move on the board
